metadata.author: Abstract Security - support@abstract.security
metadata.comments: Microsoft Sentinel Content Hub solution for Abstract Security. Deploys the connector tile, ASIM parser, two analytics rules, two hunting queries, a workbook, and three SOAR playbooks (as nested deployments), and registers the solution package. Validate with the Sentinel solution packaging tool before Content Hub submission.
metadata.description: One Azure deployment that creates the Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule and tables that Abstract Security sends events to through the Logs Ingestion API, and installs Microsoft Sentinel content for that data.
Custom table the Abstract Sentinel Destination writes to.
Connector tile logo. Defaults to the embedded Abstract Security mark (self-contained data URI).
Abstract API base URL (used by the playbooks).
Abstract vendor account id for the playbooks (x-as-vendor-account-id). Leave blank to configure later.

Key Vault secret URI for the Abstract API key, for example https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/abstract-api-key. Playbooks fetch it at runtime through their managed identity (grant each 'Key Vault Secrets User'). The key is never stored in the template. Leave empty to install the playbooks without it; they fail until it is set.

properties.descriptionHtml: Abstract Security content for Microsoft Sentinel: data connector pages for events Abstract Security delivers through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API, an ASIM parser, analytics rules installed disabled, hunting queries, workbooks and playbooks that call the Abstract API from an incident.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the Azure ingestion stack
instructionSteps.description: Deploy the **Azure Sentinel Destination** template (workspace + Sentinel + Data Collection Endpoint + custom table + Data Collection Rule + RBAC) from the Abstract Azure repo.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Create the Entra app
instructionSteps.description: Register an app + client secret and grant its service principal **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** on the DCR (the template does this when you pass the SP object id).

instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure the destination in Abstract
instructionSteps.description: In Abstract, add the **Azure Sentinel Destination** integration and paste the Client ID / Secret / Tenant ID, the **DCR Immutable ID**, the **DCE URL**, and the **Log Stream Name** (Custom-<table>) from the deployment outputs.

instructionSteps.title: 4. Route data and confirm
instructionSteps.description: Route a pipeline to the destination. Within minutes the graph above should turn green as events land in the custom table.

properties.displayName: Abstract Security - High or Critical event
properties.description: High/critical Abstract event; surfaces AbstractInsightId for the Verdict playbook.
properties.query:
AbstractEventLogs_CL
| extend AbstractEvent = iff(isnotnull(column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null))), column_ifexists('AbstractEvent', dynamic(null)), pack_all()), Message = tostring(column_ifexists('Message', ''))
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| extend e = AbstractEvent
| extend AbstractSeverity=tolower(tostring(e.severity)), SrcIpAddr=coalesce(tostring(e.source_ipv4),tostring(e.source_address)), ActorUsername=coalesce(tostring(e.user_name),tostring(e.user_id)), AbstractInsightId=coalesce(tostring(e.id), tostring(e.acs_id)), EventProduct=tostring(e.product), EventMessage=coalesce(tostring(e.message),Message)
| where AbstractSeverity in ("high","critical")
| project TimeGenerated, AbstractSeverity, EventProduct, EventMessage, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId

properties.displayName: Abstract - Repeated auth failures followed by success
properties.description: Detects a likely successful brute force / password spray: many failed authentication events followed by a success from the same source IP within a short window, using Abstract-normalized auth telemetry (ASim_AbstractEvent). Tune the EventResult terms to your products.
properties.query:
let failures = ASim_AbstractEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
  | where EventType has_any ("auth", "login", "logon") or EventResult has "fail"
  | where EventResult has_any ("fail", "failure", "denied")
  | summarize Failures = count(), FailUsers = make_set(ActorUsername, 25) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
  | where Failures >= 10;
let successes = ASim_AbstractEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
  | where EventResult has_any ("success", "succeeded", "allowed")
  | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, AbstractInsightId = AbstractEventId, EventProduct;
failures
| join kind=inner successes on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (TimeGenerated .. (TimeGenerated + 10m))
| where set_has_element(FailUsers, ActorUsername)
| project SuccessTime, SrcIpAddr, ActorUsername, Failures, EventProduct, AbstractInsightId
| sort by Failures desc

properties.displayName: Abstract - Rare or newly-seen product activity
properties.query:
ASim_AbstractEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by EventProduct, EventVendor
| where Events < 50 and FirstSeen > ago(3d)
| extend Rarity = round(1.0 / Events, 4)
| sort by Events asc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Surfaces products/sources in the Abstract pipeline that are rare or first seen in the last few days (shadow IT, misconfigured route, or attacker enabling a new logging surface).

properties.query:
ASim_AbstractEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and isnotempty(AbstractIdentity)
| summarize TotalRisk = sum(EventRiskScore), Events = count(), Products = make_set(EventProduct, 10), SrcIps = make_set(SrcIpAddr, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AbstractIdentity, ActorUsername
| where TotalRisk > 100 and array_length(Products) >= 2
| sort by TotalRisk desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Aggregates Abstract risk_score by identity over 7 days and surfaces identities whose cumulative, pipeline-scored risk crosses a threshold across multiple products — a cross-source signal the SIEM rarely sees.

connectorUiConfig.title: Abstract Security — Insights & Detections (API)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Pulls **Abstract insights, ASTRO verdicts, tune-at-source filters and pipeline metrics** into Sentinel via the Abstract API — so you get Abstract's higher-order signal **even when Sentinel is not the raw-telemetry destination**. Deploy the Abstract API Sync Logic App (below) to populate `AbstractInsights_CL`.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the Abstract API Sync Logic App

instructionSteps.title: 2. Confirm delivery
instructionSteps.description: Within the poll interval the graph above turns green as Abstract insights land in AbstractInsights_CL.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Query the Abstract insights
instructionSteps.description: The Logic App writes Abstract insights, verdicts and tune-at-source filters to AbstractInsights_CL. Query that table in Logs or add it to your own workbooks.
